function.name: releases_api_ReleasesApi_post_release
function.description: Creates a new release within the system, enabling the tracking and management of a new version of a product or a project. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

version.description: The version identifier for the release, following semantic versioning, such as '1.0.0' or '2.1.3-beta'.

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project for which the release is being created.

description.description: A brief description of the release, outlining major features or changes.

release_date.description: The scheduled date for the release in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

is_major_release.description: A boolean flag indicating if this is a major release or not.

function.name: releases_api_ReleasesApi_get_all_releases
function.description: Retrieves a list of releases based on given filters. It can be used to create, update, delete, and fetch details for existing releases. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

releaseId.description: A unique identifier for each release.

name.description: The name of the release to be retrieved, e.g., 'Release-161'.

start.description: The start time of the release as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

_from.description: The lower bound for filtering releases based on the start time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

to.description: The upper bound for filtering releases based on the start time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

maxResults.description: The maximum number of releases to retrieve. If not set, a default server-defined value will be used.

function.name: releases_api_ReleasesApi_put_release
function.description: Update the properties of an existing release using the release ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

releaseId.description: The unique identifier of the release to be updated.

releaseName.description: The new name of the release.

releaseDate.description: The updated release date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

isPublished.description: Flag indicating whether the release is published or not.

changeLog.description: Description of what has changed in this release.
